In `source/cclib/parser/orcaparser.py`, the absorption/emission spectrum block parsed every transition-property table (electric dipole, velocity dipole, combined multipole, SOC-corrected, X-ray, CASSCF) and then unconditionally did `set_attribute('etenergies', ...)` / `set_attribute('etoscs', ...)` per table. The exported `etenergies`/`etoscs` now come from the canonical `ABSORPTION SPECTRUM VIA TRANSITION ELECTRIC DIPOLE MOMENTS` table. No fixture values, names-as-data, or line numbers are hard-coded — the rule is keyed on the table identity/ordering, so it generalizes across variants and version layouts.
